shortDescription: Module for setup of ALBServicesFileDownload Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: destination_dir
options.description: Destination of the file to be saved. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: file_type
options.description: Software / crs/ inventory. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: file_uri
options.description: File uri on the cloud bucket. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: message
options.description: Downloads success / failure message. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: metadata
options.description: Metadata of the file from pulse. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the file with which it is saved to the disk. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: status
options.description: Status of file download. Enum options - SYSERR_SUCCESS, SYSERR_FAILURE, SYSERR_OUT_OF_MEMORY, SYSERR_NO_ENT, SYSERR_INVAL, SYSERR_ACCESS, SYSERR_FAULT, SYSERR_IO, SYSERR_TIMEOUT, SYSERR_NOT_SUPPORTED, SYSERR_NOT_READY, SYSERR_UPGRADE_IN_PROGRESS, SYSERR_WARM_START_IN_PROGRESS, SYSERR_TRY_AGAIN, SYSERR_NOT_UPGRADING, SYSERR_PENDING, SYSERR_EVENT_GEN_FAILURE, SYSERR_CONFIG_PARAM_MISSING, SYSERR_RANGE, SYSERR_FAILED... Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, ba

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: Tenant uuid associated with the object. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Unique id of the object. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.
